eyebrow: The registry behind every pull so far
caption: hub.docker.com -- every docker pull this course has run, from hello-world to postgres, quietly came from here. Docker's own arrow marks the Sign up button.

eyebrow: Signing in, then pushing Northbridge's own image
code:
$ docker login
Username: northbridgeretail
Password: ************
Login Succeeded

$ docker tag northbridge/catalog:1.4 northbridgeretail/catalog:1.4
$ docker push northbridgeretail/catalog:1.4
1.4: digest: sha256:9d8c7b6a... size: 1788
caption: docker tag connects a local image to a Hub namespace; docker push is what actually uploads it.

eyebrow: Creating a repository on Docker Hub
caption: Real Docker Hub UI -- Visibility is the whole decision: Public is pullable by anyone, Private is locked to accounts you grant access.
